content.title: Chapter 98 - TAXATION — Sec. 98-289. - Revocation, notice, hearing.
content.summary:
The finance director may revoke the license of any person found by the finance director
               to have violated any provisions of this article; provided, however, that any such
               revocation shall be subject to an administrative hearing as provided in
section 2-171
et seq.
